title: WarmSet@1 payload
description: The exact per-node set of carried layers one Round's Attempts start from, selected before the first AttemptDispatched@1 and listed in every Attempt's context manifest. Notes and the Head Delta come only from the previous closed Round's admitted Attempt of the same node; fenced, quarantined, malformed and released Attempts contribute nothing. A retry inherits the Round's Warm Set, never its failed sibling's state. A Head Delta over its bound is dropped at selection with a recorded reason, so no renderer can refuse an already selected Warm Set. Package P2 adds the build cache layer: the explicitly unsafe BuildCache@1 this Round's Gate captured, carried Gate to Worker within the same Round under the trusted-local policy only, or a recorded drop reason. Later packages add session and workspace layers as optional fields.

head_delta_dropped.description: Recorded when the Round's Head Delta was computed but exceeded its bound; never present beside head_delta_artifact_id.

build_cache_artifact_id.description: The review.kernel/BuildCache@1 this Round's Gate captured for the kind the node declares. Explicitly unsafe; never a Cache Snapshot.

build_cache_dropped.description: Recorded when the node declared a build cache kind and none was carried; never present beside build_cache_artifact_id.
